known_failure_modes.condition: comparing against venous concentrations (prose; not a covariate predicate)
known_failure_modes.behavior: This kernel predicts ARTERIAL concentrations. Kamp 2020 found that models fit to venous samples give substantially longer context-sensitive half-times than arterial ones; the raw-data model links the peripheral compartments to two venous delay compartments, which this 3-compartment kernel omits. Do not score it against venous samples.

extraction.tier_rationale: A pooled population model built from 14 raw data sets (Kamp 2020, alongside an 18-study meta-analysis). Volumes and clearances scale linearly with weight in the open implementation; whether the paper used linear or allometric scaling is a human item. PK-only (no effect-site link was published with it). The open reproduction drops the venous delay compartments, which leaves arterial predictions intact.
extraction.source_locator: Kamp 2020 (pooled raw-data population model, arterial central compartment)

source_review.reviewed_by: automated source cross-check (Claude Opus 5.5 via Hypnos)
source_review.method: compared the curated values against one open implementation and the primary abstract's meta-analytic values (the full text is paywalled and was not read)
sources: https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/32997732/ (abstract: weighted mean Vd 252 L/70 kg, 95% CI 200-304; CL 79 L/h at 70 kg, 95% CI 69-90)
source_review.notes: V1 25, V2 56, V3 157 L and CL 84, Q2 161, Q3 79 L/h are as coded in opentiva. The abstract confirms only the meta-analytic totals: Vss 238 L lies inside the 200-304 L CI and CL 84 L/h inside the 69-90 L/h CI. Those are a different analysis from the raw-data model, and the abstract says the two were comparable. Only ONE open implementation was found. Opentiva also codes a ke0 of 2.791/min 'from tpeak 1 min'. That is an assumption, not a published value, so it is NOT curated. HUMAN ITEMS: read the population-model table, confirm the scaling (linear vs allometric), and confirm the arterial structure.

notes: The first dissociative in Hypnos. Classic STANPUMP Domino 1984 rate constants (still in opentiva) imply a clearance about twice Domino's own Table IV value, per stanpumpR's audit. That is why the pooled Kamp model is curated instead.
